Default Reproducibility Assessment Configuration

Source: R/repro_config.R
repro_config_default.Rd

Returns the default configuration list used by assess_reproducibility() and the individual assessment functions.

Usage

repro_config_default()

Value

A list of class "repro_config" with the following elements:

max_script_depth

Maximum recommended brace nesting depth in a script before it is flagged (integer).

entry_point_names

Character vector of file names that count as a single obvious entry point.

lockfile_names

Character vector of file names or patterns that count as a captured package environment.

run_evidence_patterns

Character vector of regular expressions that match a clean run log or sessionInfo() capture.

expected_output_dir

Name of the subfolder that holds the submitted outputs an execution check should reproduce (character).

run_timeout

Maximum seconds to allow a reproduction run (integer).

cosmetic_output_ext

Character vector of output file extensions (such as rtf and pdf) whose embedded timestamps are stripped before comparison, so an output that differs only in generation time counts as analytically reproduced rather than a mismatch.

compiled_source_ext

Character vector of file extensions that mark compiled native source a reviewer must build (C, C++, Fortran).

compiled_call_patterns

Character vector of regular expressions for inline compilation calls (sourceCpp, cppFunction, R CMD SHLIB).

compiled_build_files

Character vector of build-script file names (Makevars, Makevars.win) that indicate native compilation.

toolchain_doc_pattern

Regular expression that matches documentation of the compiler toolchain (Rtools) reviewers need to build from source.

verification_patterns

Character vector of regular expressions that match an independent-verification artifact, such as an SAS vs R comparison or a QC report.

windows_risk_patterns

Named character vector of regular expressions for non-portable constructs that can break on a Windows reviewer machine (shell-outs, forking, POSIX paths).

adrg_names

Character vector of patterns matching an Analysis Data Reviewer's Guide document file name.

adrg_required_sections

Named character vector of regular expressions for the sections an ADRG should contain.

weights

Named list of relative indicator weights summing to 1: env_lockfile, path_hygiene, entry_point, hidden_setup, proprietary_pkgs, clean_run, script_depth, output_reproduction, dual_verification, adrg, windows_reviewability, compiled_toolchain.

Examples

cfg <- repro_config_default()
cfg$max_script_depth
#> [1] 6
cfg$weights$path_hygiene
#> [1] 0.12
